answer.rationale: The primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line runs at 94% with no buffer, so defer_decision or add_second_source leaves the expiring primary unaddressed and raises delivery risk. Switching primary (c2) historically cut unit cost but implies onboarding the line cannot absorb. Incumbent continuity previously kept integration and deliveries stable (c1). Renegotiation at renewal recovered margin (c4) and multi-year volume terms cut unit cost without narrowing service (c6), so negotiate_terms is the only single action that can pursue the 18% spend cut without deliberately increasing delivery risk. Prior concession size is load-bearing and uncertain relative to an 18% mandate, so c4 is the one archive pull. Close must still lock supply inside the 14-day window.
